episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: On his first day at a new high school, Park Sae Royi stands by his principles in front of powerful bullies. Oh Soo Ah works on getting into college.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: While serving his time, Sae Royi develops a bold game plan for his future. Soo Ah can't ignore a generous offer from Jang Dae Hee.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Sae Royi crosses paths with Jo Yi Seo, who seems to have a knack for bringing him trouble. Meanwhile Dan Bam struggles to attract customers.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Choi Seung Kwon regrets reverting back to his old ways. When Yi Seo's night out takes an ugly turn, Sae Royi is there to help.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Before its reopening, Dan Bam gets a few upgrades. Yi Seo, Seung Kwon and Jan Geun Soo have a surprise encounter at a nightclub.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Dae Hee keeps tabs on Dan Bam's progress. Sae Royi runs into Jang Geun Won at the TV station. Yi Seo faces her mother's disappointment.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Dan Bam gets an unwelcome visitor. Sae Royi approaches Kang Min Jung with a weighty proposition, and shares his entire story with Yi Seo.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Bad news strikes Dan Bam, but Sae Royi isn't one to bow under pressure. Geun Soo learns a horrible truth. Kim Toni deals with discrimination.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: The bar's move to a quieter street poses fresh problems for the crew. Dae Hee takes an interest in Sae Royi's people.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Jang Ga finds itself in hot water with the public. With the future of the company hanging in the balance, Dae Hee must make his choice.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: After Ma Hyun Yi makes a buzzy TV appearance, a big opportunity comes knocking for Dan Bam. Geun Soo goes after what he wants.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: While navigating their latest crisis, Sae Royi and Yi Seo come across a potential investor. Hyun Yi preps for the competition's final round.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.summary: Geun Soo moves closer to his goal. With their sights set high, Sae Royi and his team take the business to the next level.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.summary: Yi Seo overworks herself as she steps into a critical role for the team's new strategy against Jang Ga, worrying Sae Ro Yi.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.summary: Searching for Yi Seo, Seung Kwon pays his old boss a visit. Dae Hee receives a warning from Soo Ah, and a disturbing call from Geun Won.

episodes.title: Episode 16
episodes.summary: Yi Seo runs from Geun Won, who's out to put an end to everything. Desperate to salvage his crumbling legacy, Dae Hee heads to Dan Bam.
